The {{lcfirst:{{PAGENAME}}}} appears after you advance the [[inquisitor|inquisitor's quest]] a bit. It enables you to grow more vine there and store your stuff in a [[trunk]].

Otherwise, you can only clear out the old trellises and use them for growing [[grapes]] and [[hops]].

It is located southwest of Witch Hill and east of Sweet home.
